title: balance.json _comment says logic_hz=20 but the value is 10
evidence:
+  "_comment": "Balance catalog (GDD § Numerical Design, ADR-5, NFR5). The single source for every tunable number. All state-affecting values are int (ADR-10). logic_hz=20 -> 50ms/tick (ADR-2). Values are prototype-tuning ballparks (sprint-plan §8 OQ-1); retune via this file during S4 playtest.",
+  "logic_hz": 10,
+	eq(b.logic_hz, 10, "logic_hz == 10")
detail: The file's own header comment claims logic_hz=20 (50ms/tick, ADR-2), but the value is 10 (100ms/tick). test_catalogs enforces 10, so the comment is stale and every time annotation derived from it is wrong.
recommended_fix: Update the _comment to 'logic_hz=10 -> 100ms/tick', or set the value to 20 if 20Hz was intended.

title: demand.json _comment timings (~90s, 30s lead) assume 20Hz, not the configured 10Hz
evidence:
+  "_comment": "MVP demand catalog (sprint-plan §3). Per-era DemandSpecs (base, always active) + SetPieces (forecast events). The Surge = streaming ×10 for ~90s with a 30s forecast lead (the Era-3 climax the player must survive). Tunable per-era content (ADR-5) driven through the CrisisDirector seam (ADR-7). selection: weighted_random = MVP default (sprint-plan §3.3). Numbers are prototype ballparks (sprint-plan §8 OQ-1).",
+          "duration_ticks": 1800,
+          "forecast_lead_ticks": 600
+  "logic_hz": 10,
detail: The comment calls the surge '~90s with a 30s forecast lead', but at the configured 10Hz, 1800 duration ticks = 180s and 600 lead ticks = 60s — double the stated durations.
recommended_fix: Re-express the durations in ticks only, or restate them for 10Hz (180s surge, 60s lead).

title: test_topology comment says narrow.max_span 8, but the catalog max_span is 10
detail: The inline comment reads 'narrow.max_span 8', but pipe_tiers.json sets narrow max_span=10 (8 is clean_span). The span-40 case still rejects, so the test passes despite the wrong number.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to 'narrow.max_span 10' (8 is the clean_span).
